To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have calculated from first principles the two-instantons contribution to the exact solution of the Seiberg-Witten low energy effective theory for N=2 SUSY QCD.

the leading two-instanton contributions at weak coupling in Seiberg and Wittens exact solution of N=2 supersymmetric QED and QCD are given by the exact instanton contributions of the self-duel Yang-Mills equation.

the two-instantons of the exact solution are the ones predicted by Seiberg-Witten, the two-instantont contribution to the effective action is given by the two-instantant solution of the self dual equations and it agrees with the predictions of S-W.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the non-perturbatively exact solution of N=2 SUSY QCD in four spacetime dimensions.
the exact solution of the Seiberg-Witten equations for N = 2 SUSY QCD with massless and massive hypermultiplets and its implications for the low-energy dynamics of this theory.
the exact solution of the low-energy dynamics of supersymmetric gauge theory with massless matter fields.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Seiberg-Witten exact low-energy effective Lagrangian for N = 2 SUSY QCD is a correct description of the low-energy dynamics of this model.
the two-instantons of Seiberg-Witten theory are the Atiyah-Drinfeld-Hitchin-Manin two-instantons.
our calculation provides a two-instanton check for the exact solution of the low-energy effective theory of N = 1 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory with massless matter hypermultiplets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for N = 2 SUSY QCD with any number of flavors, we have found the exact solution for the low-energy dynamics, including nonperturbative effects.
the two-instantons are the only objects in the theory which are not subject to the non-perturbatative corrections.
the exact solution of the low-energy effective theory of the Seiberg-Witten type is consistent with the exact two-instaton solution of the Yang-Mills theory.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Seiberg-Witten solution of the low energy dynamics of N = 1 supersymmetric gauge theory is exact, even at weak coupling, and that the exact solution of the selfdual Yang-Mills equations provides an explicit realization of the SeibergWitten solution in terms of classical field configurations.
the two-instantons are the right degrees of freedom for the low-energy dynamics in N = 2 SYM.
the exact solution of Seiberg-Witten is a very powerful tool for calculating non-perturbatively the low-energy physics of N = 1 supersymmetric QCD.
